description: Sends feedback to the people who run ElectricityFinder: a price or plan that looks wrong, an answer that was confusing, a missing feature, or an error. It is for when the person asks to send feedback. The message holds their words about the problem, not the conversation; personal details (names, addresses, emails, ESI IDs, account numbers) do not belong in it.

kind.description: wrong_data: a price, plan or utility looks wrong. confusing: the answer was hard to use. missing_feature: something the person needed. bug: an error.

message.description: What happened and what was expected, in plain words. No names, addresses, emails or account numbers.

plan.description: Provider and plan name the feedback is about, if any.

zip.description: The ZIP the feedback is about, if any.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to ElectricityFinder
